statement: Huang referenced $100 billion in lined-up contracts when discussing how Nvidia finances AI infrastructure projects for customers, without specifying companies or time period.
why: Committed contract volume is the clearest available check on whether reported demand is backed by signed commitments rather than intent.

impact.mechanism: Lined-up contracts represent forward purchase commitments that underwrite future GPU shipments.

confidence.basis: Secondary report of a spoken remark with no counterparties or period specified and no filing corroboration.

dispersion: He did not specify which companies or what time period these commitments cover.
